Perfect! The design is **fixed and all tests pass**.

**The bug:** Line 14 had `assign in_ready = !skid_valid || out_ready;`, which made `in_ready` depend combinationally on `out_ready`. 

**The fix:** Changed it to `assign in_ready = !skid_valid;` so that `in_ready` depends only on the internal registered state (whether the skid register is valid), as required by the spec.

This ensures that `in_ready` is strictly 1 when the skid register is empty (occupancy ≤ 1) and 0 when it's full, without any combinational dependence on downstream signals like `out_ready`.
